prompts.cozinhaGrafite: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset: one landscape 16:9 high-resolution architectural photograph for the premium SURFORM solid-surface website. A realistic compact Brazilian contemporary apartment kitchen with a GRAPHITE DARK GREY acrylic solid-surface worktop and matching seamlessly integrated rectangular sink. The solid surface itself must be unmistakably graphite, not a white worktop with dark cabinets. Matte-satin homogeneous dark material with fine grazing-light microtexture, no marble veins, no granite crystals, no glossy plastic. Realistic radiused inner sink corners, one visible brushed steel drain, one chrome single-lever mixer installed on the worktop with the spout directly over the basin and an unmistakable control. Muted light-greige cabinet fronts support the dark countertop, a light warm neutral backsplash, soft morning light from a side window, restrained kitchen equipment only in the background. Architecture not a huge luxury mansion; construction plausible and quiet. High three-quarter view emphasizing the foreground sink, the dark worktop edge and its junctions, with both sink and usable preparation area in the central 30-75 percent for mobile cropping. Accurate plumbing, proportion, edge thickness, straight verticals and credible metal reflections. No people, text, logo, watermark, fictitious manufacturer, utensils in the sink, fantasy architecture or sterile CGI. One new photograph, no collage, no reference to other brands.
prompts.lavaboAreia: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset: one landscape 16:9 high-resolution architectural photograph for the premium SURFORM solid-surface website. Create a realistic small Brazilian powder room with a visibly MEDIUM SAND / WARM TAUPE acrylic solid-surface vanity and a matching integrated rounded rectangular basin. The SSM countertop and basin must both be a warm sand-taupe color noticeably deeper than ivory or white, uniformly colored matte-satin material, no marble veining, no stone crystals. Practical fabrication with gentle inner corner radii, credible visible counter edge and a round brushed metal drain. A single dark charcoal deck-mounted faucet with clearly visible lever control and spout actually over the bowl. The vanity is supported by a restrained light grey base, warm off-white textured walls, an ordinary large mirror with accurate reflections and a frosted side window. No decorative stone or wood in the foreground competing with the SSM. Tiny unbranded hand-soap dispenser only. Quiet natural side light, architecturally straight perspective, subtle real surface variation, deep focus, close three-quarter framing that shows the color and the junction from top to bowl, but enough surrounding space to read as a powder room. No people, writing, logo, watermark, brand, metallic gold finish, fake sculptural pedestal or impossible curves. Buildable residential scale. One new photograph, not a collage.
prompts.comercialCinza: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset: one landscape 16:9 high-resolution architectural photograph for the premium SURFORM solid-surface website. Main subject: a real, modestly sized commercial reception counter fabricated in a clearly MEDIUM COOL GREY acrylic solid surface. Counter approximately two meters wide, standard practical human scale. Slight off-center three-quarter perspective emphasizing the grey corner radius, countertop edge and front panel, all centrally placed for responsive cropping. Controlled architectural photography with deep focus, believable material texture and lighting, straight verticals, no glossy render look. No people, documents, text, labels, logos, watermark, fake brand sign, giant hotel lobby or science-fiction furniture. One new photograph, no collage.
